module.title: Internal ERP, Contracts, HR and Organization
module.business_purpose: Tenant-level enterprise resource management that complements the per-practice accounting subledgers (module 16/16B). Adds the organizational backbone: a general contract registry (employment, service, vendor, lease, partnership) with parties, lines, milestones and documents; and human-resources structure — departments, positions, employment records, assignments, time-off and performance — hung off the existing payroll employee master in accounting. Assets, payroll runs and vendors already modelled in accounting/billing are referenced, not duplicated.
